_notes: Per-creature drops for non-gear LootItems (quest/material/trash) - checked in combat/combat_engine.py's _resolve_victory alongside the existing gear roll. Each entry is a list of possible drops; each drop rolls independently against its own chance, so a creature can drop more than one thing from one kill.

Sagewood Sprite.name: Sagewood Petal
Sagewood Sprite.description: A fragrant petal, still cool to the touch. Old Marta wants these fresh.

Voodoo Troll.name: Hexed Darkspear Totem
Voodoo Troll.description: A Darkspear fetish, twisted by Zalazane's hex but not beyond recognizing. Still warm with old magic.

Hex Troll.name: Hexed Darkspear Totem
Hex Troll.description: A Darkspear fetish, twisted by Zalazane's hex but not beyond recognizing. Still warm with old magic.

Sunbaked Vulture.name: Sunbaked Vulture Feather
Sunbaked Vulture.description: A long, sun-bleached feather, remarkably free of scorch marks.

Kolkar Raider.name: Salvaged Caravan Crate
Kolkar Raider.description: A battered supply crate, contents mostly intact despite everything.

Kolkar Raider.name: Trampled Grain Sack
Kolkar Raider.description: A grain sack torn from a raided supply wagon, dirty but the grain inside is still good.

Kolkar Raider.name: Kolkar War-Pennant
Kolkar Raider.description: A strip of dyed hide on a bone pole. Every pennant is a boast, and each of these is a boast that did not pan out.

Kolkar Marauder.name: Sunworn Horn
Kolkar Marauder.description: A centaur's horn, bleached pale by years under the Barrens sun. Good carving material.

Southsea Brigand.name: Waterlogged Strongbox
Southsea Brigand.description: A small strongbox, swollen shut with seawater. Whatever's inside survived the crossing.

Southsea Brigand.name: Salvaged Cargo Crate
Southsea Brigand.description: A small crate with a Ratchet customs stamp half burned out. It rattles. It might be rum.

Witchwing Harpy.name: Witchwing Feather
Witchwing Harpy.description: A long, dark feather still crackling faintly with residual magic.

Bristleback Raider.name: Quilboar Battle Hide
Bristleback Raider.description: Tough, scarred hide from a quilboar warrior - good material regardless of which tribe it came from.

Bristleback Raider.name: Ceremonial Bristleback Tusk
Bristleback Raider.description: A carved tusk, worn as a mark of status among the Bristleback. Worth real money to the right collector.

Razormane Veteran.name: Quilboar Battle Hide
Razormane Veteran.description: Tough, scarred hide from a quilboar warrior - good material regardless of which tribe it came from.

Razormane Veteran.name: Razormane Quill Bundle
Razormane Veteran.description: Thick quills bound in sinew, still tacky with dried poison. Handle by the string.

Dreadmist Cultist.name: Cultist Hoarded Coin
Dreadmist Cultist.description: A pouch of coin, looted from caravans over the years and never spent.

Dreadmist Warlock.name: Cultist Hoarded Coin
Dreadmist Warlock.description: A pouch of coin, looted from caravans over the years and never spent.

Silithid Guardian.name: Hardened Silithid Chitin
Silithid Guardian.description: Tough plated chitin, useful for armor crafting.

Silithid Stinger.name: Silithid Stinger Barb
Silithid Stinger.description: A venomous barb, still faintly toxic.

Sunscale Lashtail.name: Sunscale Raptor Hide
Sunscale Lashtail.description: Tough scaled hide, prized by leatherworkers.

Sunscale Lashtail.name: Sunscale Raptor Egg
Sunscale Lashtail.description: A warm, speckled egg, carefully carried.

Sunscale Screecher.name: Sunscale Raptor Hide
Sunscale Screecher.description: Tough scaled hide, prized by leatherworkers.

Den Webspinner.name: Den Silk Spool
Den Webspinner.description: A tight spool of webspinner silk, strong enough to turn a scorpid sting. Rhaka wants these.

Cave Skitterer.name: Den Silk Spool
Cave Skitterer.description: A tight spool of webspinner silk, strong enough to turn a scorpid sting. Rhaka wants these.

Burning Blade Acolyte.name: Fel-Tainted Shard
Burning Blade Acolyte.description: A pocket-sized crystal shard, warm and wrong. Fizzcrank wants to measure it. Use tongs.

Coven Ritual Guard.name: Fel-Tainted Shard
Coven Ritual Guard.description: A pocket-sized crystal shard, warm and wrong. Fizzcrank wants to measure it. Use tongs.

Burning Blade Initiate.name: Fel-Tainted Shard
Burning Blade Initiate.description: A pocket-sized crystal shard, warm and wrong. Fizzcrank wants to measure it. Use tongs.

Durotar Prowler.name: Prowler Pelt
Durotar Prowler.description: A thick, sand-coloured pelt, still warm. Grosk says it's the best blanket money can't buy.

Mesa Stonebiter.name: Glittering Mesa Ore
Mesa Stonebiter.description: A chunk of glittering ore, still faintly gnawed. Fitz would love to know how.

Razormane Quilboar.name: Razormane Toll Pouch
Razormane Quilboar.description: A small leather pouch, heavy with other people's coin. Bok recognises the stitching.

Ragefire Digger.name: Ragefire Ore Sample
Ragefire Digger.description: Black rock shot through with orange veins. Still faintly warm, still faintly angry.

Molten Elemental.name: Ragefire Ore Sample
Molten Elemental.description: Black rock shot through with orange veins. Still faintly warm, still faintly angry.

Searing Blade Pyromancer.name: Searing Ritual Ash
Searing Blade Pyromancer.description: Grey ash that smells of sulphur and iron. Nobody burns this by accident.

Searing Blade Cultist.name: Searing Ritual Ash
Searing Blade Cultist.description: Grey ash that smells of sulphur and iron. Nobody burns this by accident.

Isle Coconut Crab.name: Sturdy Reef Coral
Isle Coconut Crab.description: Deep-red coral, tougher than the decorative kind. The crabs drag it up the beach to line their burrows.

Bilge Eel.name: Eel-Hide Cord
Bilge Eel.description: A supple length of cured eel-skin. It will hold a net together through a storm. It will not hold a grudge.

Drowned Crewman.name: Waterlogged Chart
Drowned Crewman.description: A sea chart gone to pulp at the edges. The middle is still legible: a ring of islands and a cross in red.

Waterlogged Gunner.name: Waterlogged Chart
Waterlogged Gunner.description: A sea chart gone to pulp at the edges. The middle is still legible: a ring of islands and a cross in red.

Naga Coastguard.name: Tide-Etched Naga Scale
Naga Coastguard.description: A pearly scale scored with spiral runes. The marks move if you stare at them.

Naga Tidecaller.name: Tide-Etched Naga Scale
Naga Tidecaller.description: A pearly scale scored with spiral runes. The marks move if you stare at them.

Naga Tidecaller.name: Hummingtide Pearl
Naga Tidecaller.description: A grey-green pearl that hums when you stop looking at it. The air around it smells like low tide.

Grotto Murloc.name: Tide-Touched Pearl
Grotto Murloc.description: A grey pearl that is damp no matter how long it sits in the sun.

Tidal Elemental.name: Tide-Touched Pearl
Tidal Elemental.description: A grey pearl that is damp no matter how long it sits in the sun.

Zalazane Fetish-Carver.name: Hex-Carved Bone Shard
Zalazane Fetish-Carver.description: A sliver of bone with a Darkspear name cut into it, then crossed out. Zathra says that is the worst part.

Zalazane Fetish-Carver.name: Hexed Darkspear Totem
Zalazane Fetish-Carver.description: A Darkspear fetish, twisted by Zalazane's hex but not beyond recognizing. Still warm with old magic.

Plains Thunderhawk.name: Thunderhawk Pinion
Plains Thunderhawk.description: A flight feather as long as a forearm, faintly charged. Your hair stands up when you hold it.

Kolkar Windseer.name: Kolkar Windseer Totem
Kolkar Windseer.description: A bundle of kodo-hair and bone that spins on its own when the wind is wrong. The wind is usually wrong.

Kolkar Stormer.name: Kolkar Windseer Totem
Kolkar Stormer.description: A bundle of kodo-hair and bone that spins on its own when the wind is wrong. The wind is usually wrong.

Farm Poacher.name: Grol'dom's Seed Sack
Farm Poacher.description: Burlap, stamped with a hoe. Somebody's whole next season, slung over a thief's shoulder.

Oasis Tangle-Vine.name: Tangle-Vine Heart
Oasis Tangle-Vine.description: A knot of green vine that beats, slowly, like it hasn't been told it is dead.

Drowned Pilgrim.name: Pilgrim's Prayer Beads
Drowned Pilgrim.description: Wooden beads worn smooth by one thumb, over a very long walk to a very dry pool.

Bandit Bombardier.name: Bandit Powder Keg
Bandit Bombardier.description: A small keg, a long fuse and a label that says DO NOT in three languages.

Razormane Quillthrower.name: Razormane Quill Bundle
Razormane Quillthrower.description: Thick quills bound in sinew, still tacky with dried poison. Handle by the string.

Bristleback Battleboar.name: Battleboar Tusk
Bristleback Battleboar.description: A yellowed tusk with a notch cut in it for every fight the boar won. There are a lot of notches.

Riverbank Snapper.name: Snapper Shell Plate
Riverbank Snapper.description: A palm-wide plate of river-turtle shell, thick as a sword guard and a good deal less polite.

Dreadmist Imp.name: Smouldering Imp-Heart
Dreadmist Imp.description: A cinder the size of a plum. It is still warm, and it still, faintly, giggles.

Gravel Skitterer.name: Glittering Rift Geode
Gravel Skitterer.description: A fist-sized geode that was cracked open by something with a very tidy mind. Inside, the crystals hum.

Bone-Dust Wraith.name: Giant's Knucklebone
Bone-Dust Wraith.description: A knuckle the size of your head, still faintly warm in the sun. Whatever it was attached to was not impressed by you.

Bael'dun Sergeant.name: Bael'dun Dispatch
Bael'dun Sergeant.description: A folded, wax-sealed order in tidy dwarven runes. The wax is red. So, increasingly, is the paper.

Dwarf Explosives Expert.name: Dwarven Powder Charge
Dwarf Explosives Expert.description: Brass-bound and stamped with a label that says CAREFUL in four languages. The fifth label has been scratched out.

Dig-Site Golem.name: Golem Core Shard
Dig-Site Golem.description: A chip of enchanted stone that remembers being told what to do, and is still waiting for the next order.

Modan Overseer.name: Torn Dig-Ledger Page
Modan Overseer.description: A page of numbers: ore in, ore out, workers lost. The last column has been written in a much firmer hand.

Razormane Skinner.name: Skinner's Trophy Cord
Razormane Skinner.description: A braided cord hung with ears, claws and one small bell. The bell is not a trophy. The bell is a warning.

Spire Windcaller.name: Windspire Crystal
Spire Windcaller.description: A shard of glassy sandstone that sings when held up to the wind. It does not stop when you put it down.

Brood Tunnel-Guard.name: Tunnel-Guard Chitin Plate
Brood Tunnel-Guard.description: A curved plate of chitin, hard as iron and about as friendly. It rings when you tap it. Something below answers.

Hive Weaver.name: Hive-Amber Shard
Hive Weaver.description: A shard of hard golden resin with something very small, and very annoyed, preserved inside.

Resin Spitter.name: Hive-Amber Shard
Resin Spitter.description: A shard of hard golden resin with something very small, and very annoyed, preserved inside.

Razorfen Geomancer.name: Kraul Seed-Pod
Razorfen Geomancer.description: A barbed seed-pod the size of a fist. It ticks when you hold it. Oggra wants them gone from the hill.

Razorfen Ward-Keeper.name: Ward Seal-Stone
Razorfen Ward-Keeper.description: A palm-sized stone etched with a binding ward, still warm from the force that held the pit shut.

Fang Initiate.name: Fang Totem Shard
Fang Initiate.description: A shard of green-glazed clay, scratched with a coiled serpent. Initiates break one at the end of each rite.

Nightmare Wisp.name: Nightmare Dewdrop
Nightmare Wisp.description: A bead of dew that does not evaporate. It sees things; you would rather it did not tell you.

Mutanus the Devourer.name: Naralex's Dream-Pearl
Mutanus the Devourer.description: A pearl of green light, warm as a heartbeat. Naralex dreamed it, once, before the nightmare did the dreaming.

Slug.name: Slug Venom Gland
Slug.description: A wet, mustard-coloured gland. It is warmer than it has any right to be, and it twitches.

Peat Shambler.name: Peat Heart
Peat Shambler.description: A fist of dense black peat that holds its shape like muscle. It is faintly, unnervingly pulsing.

Sentinel Picket.name: Sentinel Signal Horn
Sentinel Picket.description: A curved silver horn, still warm from a night-elf mouth. One long call and the pickets know where the Horde is.

Pumpjack Guard.name: Pumpjack Pressure Gauge
Pumpjack Guard.description: A brass gauge, needle pinned at the red. The Venture Co. does not stamp its name on these. It stamps a price.

Sludge Elemental.name: Crude Sludge Sample
Sludge Elemental.description: A stoppered flask of the sludge that is not strictly oil, anymore, and not strictly dead.

Kolkar Dervish.name: Dervish Curved Blade
Kolkar Dervish.description: A short, hooked blade, hot to the touch. Dervishes spin until they glow. The blades take longer to cool.

Road Bandit.name: Highwayman's Ledger
Road Bandit.description: A greasy tally of caravans, with prices, in a very neat hand. The neatness is the disturbing part.

Witchwing Windcaller.name: Witchwing Hex-Totem
Witchwing Windcaller.description: Feathers, knucklebone and a thread of human hair. It hums in a key that makes your fillings ache.

Cavern Rock Elemental.name: Vein Core Sample
Cavern Rock Elemental.description: A palm-sized core of crystal-veined rock, still ringing from the drill that did not finish it.

Ore Sprite.name: Ore Sprite Shard
Ore Sprite.description: A shard of living crystal that hums quietly and goes cold when you look at it for too long.

Roost Bonepicker.name: Roost Down
Roost Bonepicker.description: A handful of grey-brown down. Harpies line their nests with it, and the nests are not clean.

Twilight Rootbinder.name: Blighted Root Sample
Twilight Rootbinder.description: A fist-sized knot of root, black at the core and still faintly warm. The Moonwell's sap runs through it, and it is wrong.

Gloomcap Sporeling.name: Gloomcap Spore Sac
Gloomcap Sporeling.description: A swollen sac that smells of old cellars. Handle it gently, and then don't.

Timberling.name: Timberling Heartwood
Timberling.description: A hand-length of dense, red-gold heartwood, still faintly warm. The wards at Maestra's Post are carved from exactly this.

Elder Timberling.name: Timberling Heartwood
Elder Timberling.description: A hand-length of dense, red-gold heartwood, still faintly warm. The wards at Maestra's Post are carved from exactly this.

Furbolg Shaman.name: Corrupted Furbolg Totem
Furbolg Shaman.description: A bone-and-sinew totem with something black seeping through the carving. It hums when you stop paying attention to it.

Wisp.name: Wisp-Light Essence
Wisp.description: A pale mote of light in a pinch of dew. It does not burn, and it will not stay in a closed fist.

Nightsaber Stalker.name: Windrunner Family Locket
Nightsaber Stalker.description: A small silver locket, dented by teeth, with a painted portrait of a family inside. Thessaly will know it.

Fel Imp.name: Scavenged Outpost Scrap
Fel Imp.description: A bent hinge, a strap buckle, a scrap of Horde canvas. Carried off and hoarded by something that can't possibly have a use for any of it.

Ragged Scavenger.name: Stolen Village Scrap
Ragged Scavenger.description: Supplies pulled out of Deathknell's stores: a tin of salt, a bundle of rope. They were counted carefully the day before they went missing.

Ragged Scavenger.name: Stolen Cargo Crate
Ragged Scavenger.description: A small crate, battered and half-opened.

Agamand Servant.name: Shackle Key
Agamand Servant.description: A heavy iron key, cold as a grave. It fits the locks on the farmers' shackles.

Frostbitten Huntsman.name: Cracked Hunting Horn
Frostbitten Huntsman.description: A horn of pale bone, split down one side. It still tries to sound when the wind finds it.

Felguard Legionnaire.name: Legion Brand Plate
Felguard Legionnaire.description: A palm-sized plate of fel-iron stamped with the Legion's mark. The edges are still warm.

Burning Blade Cultist.name: Blood-Written Orders
Burning Blade Cultist.description: A scrap of hide with a few lines of crabbed script, written in something that is not ink. The lines don't agree with each other.

Forest Spider.name: Heavy Spider Silk
Forest Spider.description: A skein of silk as thick as a bowstring, tacky and strong. It would hold a grown bear.

Murloc Hydra.name: Hydra Fang
Murloc Hydra.description: A curved fang as long as your hand, still wet. Whatever it bit had it twice.

Restless Grave-Dweller.name: Weathered Grave Marker
Restless Grave-Dweller.description: A splintered marker with half a name. Somebody was loved, once.

Grave Rat.name: Weathered Grave Marker
Grave Rat.description: A splintered marker with half a name. Somebody was loved, once.

Wretched Zombie.name: Tattered Burial Shroud
Wretched Zombie.description: Good linen, ruined. Sexton Marrow will know whose.

Rattlecage Skeleton.name: Tattered Burial Shroud
Rattlecage Skeleton.description: Good linen, ruined. Sexton Marrow will know whose.

Claim Spider.name: Spun Gold Thread
Claim Spider.description: Spider-silk laced with real gold dust. Glints in the dark.

Drowned Wretch.name: Tarnished Keepsake
Drowned Wretch.description: A ring, a locket, a ribbon. Somebody left it at the pond.

Drowned Wretch.name: Iceshard Fragment
Drowned Wretch.description: A shard of black ice that does not melt.

Weeping Shade.name: Tarnished Keepsake
Weeping Shade.description: A ring, a locket, a ribbon. Somebody left it at the pond.

Weeping Shade.name: Iceshard Fragment
Weeping Shade.description: A shard of black ice that does not melt.

Burned Farmhand.name: Unburnt Seed Packet
Burned Farmhand.description: Paper, singed at the edges. The seeds inside are still good.

Blighted Scarecrow.name: Unburnt Seed Packet
Blighted Scarecrow.description: Paper, singed at the edges. The seeds inside are still good.

Scarlet Picket.name: Scarlet Dispatch
Scarlet Picket.description: Orders for tomorrow's burning, in a neat clerical hand.

Scarlet Torchbearer.name: Scarlet Dispatch
Scarlet Torchbearer.description: Orders for tomorrow's burning, in a neat clerical hand.

Vile Fin Minor Oracle.name: Oracle's Pearl
Vile Fin Minor Oracle.description: A salt-white pearl, cold and faintly humming.

Vile Fin Puddlejumper.name: Oracle's Pearl
Vile Fin Puddlejumper.description: A salt-white pearl, cold and faintly humming.

Scarlet Convert.name: Crusade Orders
Scarlet Convert.description: Folded orders, signed in a neat red hand.

Scarlet Initiate.name: Crusade Orders
Scarlet Initiate.description: Folded orders, signed in a neat red hand.

Solliden Farmhand.name: Moldering Locket
Solliden Farmhand.description: A tarnished locket. The inscription on the back is still legible.

Agamand Crypt Wight.name: Grave Relic
Agamand Crypt Wight.description: A small carved token from the Agamand vault.

Rot Hide Graverobber.name: Grave Relic
Rot Hide Graverobber.description: A small carved token from the Agamand vault.

Bethor Iceshard.name: Iceshard Fragment
Bethor Iceshard.description: A shard of black ice that does not melt.

Faol's Restless.name: Faol's Seal Fragment
Faol's Restless.description: A carved stone fragment, worn smooth by pilgrims.

Venomweb Skitterer.name: Venom Sac
Venomweb Skitterer.description: A swollen gland that oozes at a touch.

Vicious Night Web Spider.name: Venom Sac
Vicious Night Web Spider.description: A swollen gland that oozes at a touch.

Cult Acolyte.name: Cult Ledger Page
Cult Acolyte.description: A page of names, tallies and debts.

Cult Fanatic.name: Cult Ledger Page
Cult Fanatic.description: A page of names, tallies and debts.

Lordaeron Remnant.name: Lordaeron Signet
Lordaeron Remnant.description: A tarnished ring bearing the old court's crest.

Rotting Dead.name: Moldering Locket
Rotting Dead.description: A tarnished locket. The inscription on the back is still legible.

Scarlet Bowman.name: Bloodied Scarlet Orders
Scarlet Bowman.description: Crusade orders, torn and stained. Troop positions and patrol times.

Scarlet Zealot.name: Bloodied Scarlet Orders
Scarlet Zealot.description: Crusade orders, torn and stained. Troop positions and patrol times.

Scourge Necromancer.name: Scourge Rune Shard
Scourge Necromancer.description: A shard of black rune-stone, etched and cold to the touch.

Scourge Warrior.name: Scourge Rune Shard
Scourge Warrior.description: A shard of black rune-stone, etched and cold to the touch.

Plaguemaster Orvyn.name: Plaguemaster's Formula
Plaguemaster Orvyn.description: Stained notes, dosages and a diagram of the cult's delivery vats.

Plague Spore.name: Sump Sludge Vial
Plague Spore.description: A stoppered vial of the green-grey sludge the Cistern breeds. The glass is warm.

Rot Worm.name: Sump Sludge Vial
Rot Worm.description: A stoppered vial of the green-grey sludge the Cistern breeds. The glass is warm.

Plague Surgeon.name: Surgeon's Case Notes
Plague Surgeon.description: Bloodstained pages in a steady hand. The last entries are less steady.

Blighted Courtier.name: Courtier's Blighted Ledger
Blighted Courtier.description: A court ledger, every name struck through and every sum still correct.

Failed Experiment.name: Vat-Born Tissue
Failed Experiment.description: A fist of grey tissue that is still working out what it was meant to be.

The Infected Noble.name: Faulkner Signet
The Infected Noble.description: A heavy gold ring set with the crest of a house that no longer exists. The crest is wet.

Plague Keeper Voss.name: Voss's Plague Codex
Plague Keeper Voss.description: A ledger bound in something that used to be skin. Every page is a recipe.

Plagued Courier.name: Unsealed Plague Vial
Plagued Courier.description: A sealed vial taken off a courier, stamped with the Apothecary Society's wax. A hairline crack.

Skeletal Groundskeeper.name: Groundskeeper's Ledger Scrap
Skeletal Groundskeeper.description: A torn fragment of a ledger in the Cult's cipher, folded small.

Silverpine Spider.name: Silverpine Venom Gland
Silverpine Spider.description: A greenish gland, still faintly pulsing.

Risen Farmhand.name: Farthing Seed Sack
Risen Farmhand.description: A small, singed sack of wheat seed.

Risen Farmhand.name: Farmhand's Silver Locket
Risen Farmhand.description: A small silver locket on a broken chain. The clasp is stuck.

Grave Moss Creeper.name: Grave-Moss Clipping
Grave Moss Creeper.description: Grey-green moss, thick with bone dust.

Dead Field Harrower.name: Harrower's Straw Charm
Dead Field Harrower.description: A sewn straw charm, stitched in a wife's careful hand.

Orchard Shambler.name: Rotapple Core
Orchard Shambler.description: A black, heavy seed-core, faintly warm.

Rot Hide Slitherer.name: Slitherer Fang
Rot Hide Slitherer.description: A curved, wet fang. Handle with tongs.

Venomfang Skitterer.name: Skitterer Egg Sac
Venomfang Skitterer.description: A silk-wrapped egg sac, warm to the touch.

Blighted Crow.name: Tarnished Gold Ring
Blighted Crow.description: A gold band, pecked loose from a nest. Inscribed on the inside.
